rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Chunk 2 raw:13-15 bolds Verification/Absorption/Outcome and defines each in the SAME chunk before any pronoun leans on them. Chunk 3 raw:20 "the problems" resolves to the three concerns just named in chunk 2 (same file, sequential read); raw:21 "the session" resolves to "the session you send off in this module" named in chunk 1 raw:8.

No sentence points at another file by position. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "the X you did/saw/caught" construction referencing a specific prior exercise/lecture beat appears anywhere in the body; grep for "you did"/"you saw"/"you caught" over the file returns nothing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal construction present; this is a 5-minute framing opener with no demo/predict instruction.

Each chunk carries a self-standing claim: chunk 1 reveals the far half of the map (figure + 2 bullets); chunk 2 names and defines the three new concerns; chunk 3 states the un-packaged-run premise and closes on a question. None is a bare wait-state bullet.

Chunk 1 header "Back to the map: the far half opens" is true of its content (the map figure with the far half lit). Chunk 2 header "Long-running work adds three new concerns" is true (three bolded phase bullets follow). Chunk 3 header "Your first un-packaged long session" is true (the un-packaged session is the chunk's whole subject). No header is contradicted by its own chunk.

"Not X. Not Y. Z." — none present (grep for "Not " returns nothing in body). Anaphora/epistrophe triples — chunk 2's three phase bullets are the closest candidate (Verification/Absorption/Outcome each opens a bullet) but the lead verbs differ ("tells you" / "determines" / "determines") and each carries distinct concrete content (what it measures, what it costs, what it does to throughput/survival) rather than a hollow third leg. Self-grading superlatives — none (no "one of the most"/"most useful" phrasing). Number + retraction — no bare numeral claims in body. Abstraction-noun stacks — none; "the gap between the two" (raw:14) names a concrete comparison, not an abstraction stack. Verb-triplet-with-empty-leg — none; the three phase bullets are separate slide-level bullets, not one triplet sentence, and each verb (tells/determines/determines) answers "what does this concretely mean" on its own.
